plugin.plugin_translation.name: Translation
plugin.plugin_translation.description: Translate messages with DeepL: react with a flag (🇩🇪, 🇫🇷, 🇯🇵 …) to translate a message into that language, or use /translate. 32 languages, chosen channels and roles, a daily limit.
plugin.plugin_translation.setting.tier_h: Free: 500,000 characters a month (keys ending in ":fx"). The key goes under Admin → API / Secrets as DEEPL_API_KEY with the value "DeepL-Auth-Key <your key>".
plugin.plugin_translation.setting.daily_: 0: no limit (up to 2000). Protects the DeepL quota.
plugin.plugin_translation.setting.char_l: Longer texts are refused by /translate and cut by Quick-Translation.
plugin.plugin_translation.setting.flags_: React with 🇩🇪, 🇫🇷, 🇯🇵 … on a message: the bot posts it in that language.
plugin.plugin_translation.setting.trigge: These emojis translate into the target language below, e.g. 🌐.
plugin.plugin_translation.setting.target: Target language of the extra emojis
Flags always use their own language. Code or name: AR, BG, CS, DA, DE, EL, EN-GB, EN-US, ES, ET, FI, FR, HU, ID, IT, JA, KO, LT, LV, NB, NL, PL, PT-BR, PT-PT, RO, RU, SK, SL, SV, TR, UK, ZH.
plugin.plugin_translation.setting.quick_: Only members with one of these roles. Empty: everyone.
plugin.plugin_translation.setting.defaul: When the command has no "to". Code or name, e.g. DE, EN-US, French.
plugin.plugin_translation.setting.privat: Only the caller sees the translation.
plugin.plugin_translation.node.translate: Translates a text with DeepL into a language (code like DE or a name).
